question: Choose the correct meaning of Idiom "Throw down the gauntlet"
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Throw down the gauntlet"** means to issue a challenge to someone in a bold or defiant manner. (किसी को चुनौती देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The CEO threw down the gauntlet by challenging his competitors to innovate faster.
 
 
• This idiom originates from medieval times when knights would throw down their gauntlets (metal gloves) as a challenge for combat.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Challenge someone boldly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Show fear in public** (सार्वजनिक रूप से डर दिखाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was nervous during the speech but managed not to show fear in public.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Make peace** (शांति स्थापित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After years of rivalry, the two neighbors decided to make peace.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Avoid confrontation** (टकराव से बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** He chose to avoid confrontation and walked away from the argument.
 
 

45:Tafc,

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Fall victim to one's own plan**.
